# RetinomorphicIontronicArray

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
An array of photo-iontronic devices that mimics retinal processing, combining light sensing and synaptic computation in a single physical layer. Directly implements in-network sensory preprocessing, reducing data movement and latency for vision-driven TCC/iNEST applications.
